# Example model card using simple_shapes.root (generated by simple_shapes.py).
#
# Step 1: generate the shapes workspace in the examples/roomodel directory:
#   python simple_shapes.py

# Step 3: run analysis:
#   python python/pymodel roomodel analyze --model-file model.root --toys 50
